name: Rajasthan Grid Emission Factor
description: Marginal grid carbon intensity for Northern Regional Grid (Rajasthan state bus).
source: Central Electricity Authority (CEA) CO₂ Baseline Database Version 19
derivationMethod: Weighted average operating margin of thermal power stations connected to Northern Grid.
uncertaintyNotes: Official CEA regulatory factor; does not account for intraday diurnal solar displacement.

name: Jaipur Solar Specific Yield
description: Annual energy yield per installed kWp for south-facing mono-PERC arrays (tilt 26°).
source: NREL PVWatts & Rajasthan Renewable Energy Corporation Ltd (RREC)
derivationMethod: Hourly irradiance modeling adjusted for 3.2% Jaipur regional soiling degradation.
uncertaintyNotes: Subject to monsoon cloud cover and seasonal dust storm cleaning schedules (±4.5% variance).

name: BESS Round-Trip AC Efficiency
description: Full-cycle AC-to-AC round-trip efficiency for Lithium Iron Phosphate (LFP) containerized system.
source: Manufacturer Factory Acceptance Test (FAT) & Spec Sheet
derivationMethod: Metered bidirectional AC test including inverter losses, auxiliary cooling, and BMS overhead.
uncertaintyNotes: Efficiency degrades to ~84% during peak summer when ambient temperatures exceed 44°C.

name: 500-Acre Campus Rainwater Harvesting Envelope
description: Theoretical annual rainwater harvesting volume potential over the 500-acre Dhun watershed.
source: Dhun Hydrology & Watershed Masterplan (550 mm annual rainfall × 500 acres × runoff coeff)
derivationMethod: Catchment runoff model across contour swales, lakes, and recharge basins. (Note: NOT active structural tank storage).
uncertaintyNotes: Subject to erratic interannual monsoon rainfall distributions (historic range: 380 mm to 720 mm).

name: Potable Domestic Water Demand Baseline
description: Design water allowance per resident for rural/semi-arid field station campuses.
source: CPHEEO Manual on Water Supply and Treatment, Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs
derivationMethod: Standard Indian engineering benchmark for residential communities with full flushing sewerage.
uncertaintyNotes: Actual field station consumption ranges from 90 to 125 L/person/day under water conservation fixtures.

name: Campus Soil Organic Carbon Stock Baseline
description: Total standing soil carbon pool across 500-acre regenerated agroforestry landscape (0-30cm).
source: Field Station Baseline Soil Core Sampling & Laboratory Analysis
derivationMethod: Dry combustion elemental analyzer on 120 composite core samples across 8 site parcels.
uncertaintyNotes: Sampling error ±6.8%. Strictly standing capital stock — NEVER to be counted as annual removal.

name: Agroforestry Annual Carbon Removal Rate
description: Annual biological net carbon removal flux into above-ground woody biomass and root systems.
source: Allometric Growth Curves for Indigenous Rajasthan Flora (Khejri, Neem, Rohida)
derivationMethod: DBH (diameter at breast height) increment measurements combined with species allometric equations.
uncertaintyNotes: Calculated flux; depends on sapling survival rates and summer irrigation availability.

name: Compute Commons Design PUE
description: Power Usage Effectiveness design ceiling for containerized AI compute cluster with direct liquid cooling.
source: Compute Commons Technical Design Specification Rev 2.1
derivationMethod: Total Facility Power (IT + Direct Warm Water Loop + Secondary Chiller) divided by IT Power.
uncertaintyNotes: PUE rises to ~1.28 during extreme summer heatwaves (>45°C ambient) when dry coolers require adiabatic boost.

name: BESS Cell Critical Thermal Alarm
description: Maximum allowable cell surface temperature before emergency BMS shutdown.
source: UL 9540A Standard for Thermal Runaway Evaluation & Cell Manufacturer Manual
derivationMethod: Electrochemical thermal stability threshold for lithium iron phosphate cells.
uncertaintyNotes: Mandatory safety limit. Warning alert fires at 45.0°C; critical trip at 55.0°C.
